GOVERNMENT OF TELANGANA
OFFICE OF THE DISTRICT COLLECTOR AND MAGISTRATE;
KAMAREDDY DISTRICT
NOTIFICATION
Ref:No.2835/E-I/RDDW/KMR/2026 Date:19-10-2026
Sub: Department of AYUSH – National AYUSH Mission-Engaging various
categories of services on outsourcing basis to carry out AYUSH
Public Health Programmes in Kamareddy District on outsourcing
basis to work under the administrative control of Director,
Department of AYUSH, T.G., Secunderabad up to 31/3/2027 –
Regarding.
****
Government vide G.O.Rt.No.1508, Fin (HRM.VII) Dept., Dt:21/08/2026
have accord permission for(333) various categories of services i.e., thirty eight
(38) services on contract and two hundred and ninety five (295) services on
outsourcing basis, the Director, Department of AYUSH, T.G., Secunderabad
have requested the Collector & District Magistrate, Kamareddy District to fill
up only (08) posts in (6) categories which are sanctioned in Kamareddy District
through District Selection Committee (DSC) as the posts are exclusively meant
for AYUSH Department under Public Health Programme in National AYUSH
Mission.
Hence, Applications are invited for the following posts to work on
outsourcing basis under AYUSH Public Health Programmes in Kamareddy
District up to 31.03.2027 under the administrative control of Director,
Department of AYUSH, T.G., Secunderabad.
The applications will be received for the above said posts from Date:
24-10-2026 to Date: 31-10-2026 between 10:30AM to 05:00PM (on
working days). Applications are to be submitted in person or through
Registered Post at Room Number: 25, O/o: Collector and District
Magistrate, Kamareddy District. The applications, which are received after
the due date (i.e., Date: 31-10-2026), will be summarily rejected. District
Selection Committee is not responsible for the postal delays.
The remuneration and educational qualifications prescribed for the
respective categories shall be as specified in the approved guidelines and
Government Orders.
I. METHODOF RECRUITMENT:
The recruitment is to be made on outsourcing basis up to 31.03.2027
and thereafter the services will be as per the need and also subject to
satisfactory performance.
The recruitment shall be done by the District Selection Committee of the
District Health Society.
The District Selection Committee shall consist of the following members:
a) District Collector : Chairman
b) Concerned Regional Deputy Director,
Department of AYUSH : Member/
Convener
c) DMHO : Member
d) Deputy Director Social Welfare : Member
e) DCHS : Member
f) AYUSH District Nodal Officer : Member
2
Selections will be done based on the following criteria
a) Total Marks are 100 of which 90 marks will be allotted basing on the
marks obtained in qualifying examination for AYUSH Doctor with PG
Qualification, AYUSH Medical Officer, Pharmacists, Dieticians,
Psychosocial Counselor and Yoga Professional.
b) For Multi-Purpose-Worker, 90 marks will be allotted for written test
conducted by the concerned authorities.
c) For all the posts,(10)marks will be awarded for the age. Weightage for age
will be reckoned from 18 years of age of the candidate 0.5 mark will be
awarded for one completed year of age with a maximum of 10marks. The
age will be reckoned as on 1.7.2026 (Example 1, If a candidate completes
20 years as on 1.7.2026, he will be awarded 1.0 mark; Example 2. If a
candidate completes 30 years of age as on 1.7.2026, he/she will be
awarded 6.0 marks, Example 3. If a candidate completes 40 years of age
as on 1.7.2026, he/she will be awarded 10.0 marks).
d) Merit list will be prepared based on the marks obtained with above
criteria and displayed on website for transparency.
e) Selectionlistwillbepreparedfromthefinalizedmeritlistdulyfollowing the
rule of reservation and Presidential Order.
f) For Psychosocial Counselor, a panel of eligible candidates may be
empaneled. The empaneled candidates shall be engaged on a call basis,
as and when their services are required.

V. AGE
The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 44 years. The
minimum and maximum age shall be reckoned as on 01/07/2026 with the
following relaxations allowed for reckoning the maximum age limit as per
rules:
i. For S.C’s, S.T’s & BC’s 5 (Five) years.
ii. ForEx-Serviceman3(Three) years in addition to the length of service in
armed forces.
iii. Disable persons 10 (ten) years.
VI. RULEOF RESERVATION:
Rules of Reservation in respect of Community, Disability, Ex-service Men
shall be strictly observed as per the Telangana State and Subordinate Service
Rules, 1996, read with the relevant Specific Rules applicable.
The Rule of Reservation of Local candidates is applicable as per
Presidential order.
